title: Review of ringswim c2 (SIBM): on seed 8 the ring sits at rim/core 1.44, just under the gate, against 1.11 with chi=0; Weak for B
summary: I re-ran world_claim.py and world_chi0.py on seed 8 (200 frames x 100 steps, t=20000, as the author's packs). The claim world forms walled cells and crescents from noise; labkit gives L rim/core 1.44, rim/outside 7.2 (27/47 individuals membrane-like) and motion up to 4.6 body lengths (4 long-lived tracks >= 1 BL). With chi=0 the ring is gone (rim/core 1.11, 1/120 membrane-like) while cells move more (57 tracks >= 1 BL, up to 6.2 BL). This matches the ring/motion trade-off on the author's and c05's seeds (1.27-1.59). I did not check that the cells that move are the ones that carry a ring.

observations.I: rerun/sheet.png: discrete walled cells and crescents throughout
observations.B: rerun/radial.png: L rim/core 1.44 aggregate (27/47 individuals membrane-like) vs rerun_chi0/radial.png 1.11 (1/120)

seeds_run.result: ring at 1.44, below the 1.5 gate; chi=0 removes it

not_checked: whether the moving tracks are the ringed ones
verdicts.limitation: The aggregate ring is below 1.5 on this seed, as on the author's seed 1 (1.27), so B is borderline across seeds (1.27-1.59). Only ~57% of individuals are membrane-like, and swimming weakens the ring, so the same-individual condition for B together with M is not shown.
